My part of round 183 (M4) is done: the cookie banner no longer renders on `/studio*`. I checked the baseline first (HEAD `f22290f`, frozen list of 1005 OK, both start hashes OK). Nothing is committed or pushed, and no protected file was touched.

**Changed files (exactly the 4 B granted):**
- `CookieConsent.tsx`: three small changes, L1–L3. It reads the current path with `useLocation`, checks `isStudioRoute = pathname.startsWith('/studio')` before any return, and returns nothing on Studio routes. The JSX, styles, timer and handlers are unchanged.
- New test file `app/components/common/__tests__/CookieConsent.test.tsx`: CC1–CC5 exactly as B wrote them, plus one extra test, CC4b. CC4b checks that a banner already showing on a Store page disappears when you navigate into the Studio. I added it because the code-reviewer flagged that direction as untested.
- Doc 150: only the D1 lines.
- New doc 151, in Georgian, with the D2 content.

**Checks I actually ran:**
- Test file: 8/8 passed.
- `npm run typecheck`: 0 errors.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0.
- Biome on the 2 code files: 3 warnings (buttons with no `type`). They are in the frozen JSX and the HEAD version of the file has the same 3, so I left them alone. The test file is clean.

**Mutations m308–m311:** each file was restored and its hash checked afterwards. m308, m309 and m311 turned exactly the expected tests red and kept the expected ones green. **m310 does not fully match §4.1:** one CC5 case ("a decision already exists, so nothing shows on `/`") stays green. It cannot turn red: with a saved decision the banner never becomes visible, whatever the route check says. I didn't weaken any test; B needs to rule on this.

**Code review:** I ran the real `code-reviewer` subagent. It scored the change 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings, and I addressed its cheap points in my own files: CC4b, and doc 151 now lists all four denied gtag consent keys plus the Facebook Pixel revoke. One point is not addressed because it is outside M4 scope: the `fbq` branch is never exercised in tests. Its Architecture note, passed verbatim in the report, is "keep" for now: the Studio route check now exists twice (`root.tsx:137` and `CookieConsent.tsx:16`). It suggests sharing it once `root.tsx` is unfrozen.

**For B to decide:** the reviewer also pointed out that visitors who enter only through the Studio are never asked for consent. They stay at the default "denied", so it is privacy-safe but loses analytics. This is ruling R45, and changing it needs Saba.

**Not done by me, still open:** all browser rows are C's (BANNER-STUDIO-M4, BANNER-STORE-M4, NAV-M4, STUDIO-RV-M4, M3-NEIGHBOUR, G183-3, PX-NET / REG-HYD). The banner never shows on the shared :5173 server because it has no GA environment, so C needs its own servers on :5174 and :5175 as §5 describes. The full suite, build and verify belong to the root gate. M4 is not done until C passes it.
